real_s1.explanation: The unit fires most on vehicles and boxy man-made devices such as cars, trucks, cameras and radios. Within those classes its preferences are weak. It is somewhat more active when the main subject sits fully inside the frame at a moderate size rather than filling or overflowing the photo. It also responds slightly more to cool blue or green toned photos. The preference for centered subjects over right-third subjects appears shared with similar units, so it is not particular to this one. No row reaches the 95th percentile, so all predictions are tentative.

real_s2.explanation: This unit responds to vehicles and boxy devices (cars, trucks, buses, cameras, radios) and is somewhat stronger when the object is fully inside the photo at a moderate size, centered rather than off to the right, and when the image has a cool blue or green tint. None of the observed contrasts reach the 95th percentile, so its selectivity for these photo properties is weak. The left-versus-right centering effect is largely shared with similar units. Whole-object framing and cool tint look most particular to this unit.

real_s3.explanation: This unit responds to vehicles and boxy devices (cars, trucks, vans, cameras, radios). Within those classes it is somewhat more active when the subject is fully visible and occupies a moderate part of the frame, rather than filling it or being cut off. It is also more active when the photo has a cool blue or green tint. No row reaches the 95th percentile, so the evidence is weak. The strongest unit-specific signals are framing (subject fully inside the photo) and cool tint. Centering effects are shared with similar units.

null_s1.explanation: The unit responds to vehicles and boxy machines (cars, trucks, vans, buses, cameras, radios), and within those classes it favors a subject facing or pointing left over one facing right. It also leans toward subjects lit at medium rather than bright, filling a moderate share of the frame, and present as a clear single subject rather than a scene with no main subject. The left-versus-right preference is the strongest and most distinctive signal; the similar units are only moderate on it.

null_s2.explanation: The unit responds to vehicles and boxy devices (cars, trucks, vans, cameras, radios). Within those classes it is most active when the subject faces or points left, or toward or away from the camera, and least active when it faces right. It also prefers medium rather than bright lighting and subjects filling a quarter to three quarters of the frame. Activity drops when there is no single main subject. Row 1 (left more than right) is the strongest row specific to this unit, since the similar units sit at percentiles 35 to 87 there.

null_s3.explanation: The unit responds to vehicles and boxy machines (cars, trucks, vans, cameras, radios), and within those classes it is most active when the main subject faces or points left rather than right. It also favors photos where the subject fills a moderate share of the frame and is lit at medium rather than bright. The left-vs-right preference is the strongest distinctive signal, since the similar units sit well below 95 on that row.
